title: OutboxStore enqueue not idempotent unlike enqueue_receipt
description: enqueue() uses plain INSERT so a duplicate (message_id, peer_user_id, kind='message') call returns KithError::Validation surfaced as invalidArguments. enqueue_receipt() uses ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE and is idempotent. The asymmetry is a contributor footgun. Fix: enqueue() should use INSERT OR IGNORE, or document that callers must never call it twice.
